jsonld_raw.name: (220 G) FLORAL SILK SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made with vegetable waxes.

Floral Silk | A luminous and juicy opening that evokes the delicacy of traditional Polish gardens and fabrics. The coconut and jasmine heart provides a silky and enveloping softness. A vanilla and musk base envelops the fragrance with timeless elegance.

OLFACTORY NOTES
Top notes: passionfruit
Heart notes: coconut, jasmine
Base notes: vanilla, musk
